title: HB0040 (110th General Assembly): As introduced, enacts the "Open Carry Firearms Freedom Act." - Amends TCA Title 10, Chapter 7; Title 33; Title 38; Title 39; Title 40 and Title 70.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2017-01-12; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 1456702)
provenance.note: Draft (as filed) dated 2017-01-12. Title is "Open Carry Firearms Freedom Act." SECTION 2 replaces 39-17-1307(a): the club-carry offense stays; only fully concealed handguns without a permit stay an offense; penalties are fine-only. SECTIONS 3, 5, 6 quotes are instruction sentences. The SECTION 2 (a)(2) quote stops at a page break; the sentence goes on to "directive issued pursuant to § 39-17-1315 or handgun carry permit issued or recognized in this state pursuant to § 39-17-1351." SECTION 7 bars the department of safety from changing permit wording. Draft text: adopted amendments are not in the text read and could change it.

SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1308): is amended by deleting subdivisions (a)(1) and (a)(5) in their entireties.
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)): A person entering the property who does not remove any firearm from a vehicle; provided, however, that the person may remove a firearm from a vehicle for the limited purpose of storing it in or on another portion of the vehicle or another vehicle.
